title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next GSQ-RCO IQ3_XXS (47 GB resident) on llama.cpp
slug_note: The 180B MoE at 3 bits: 47 GB must sit in memory, the 28.8 GB n-gram table can stay on SSD.

variation.quant_detail: GSQ-RCO IQ3_XXS, 3.00 bits/weight: 75.8 GB download = 47.0 GB resident shard + 28.8 GB n-gram shard that can stay memory-mapped on disk. Q2_0: 37.6 GB resident.

engine.config: llama.cpp with the n-gram shard memory-mapped (-lm mmap --lazy-mode on)

requirements.notes: Card: shard 1 (47.0 GB) must be resident; shard 2 (28.8 GB) can stay on an SSD. Add KV headroom and 0.91 GB for the vision projector. Estimate, not measured.

steps.text: Install llama.cpp (see Step 0 in Quick start).
Download both IQ3_XXS shards from ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-GGUF (the card's command: hf download <this-repo> --include "IQ3_XXS/*" --local-dir .). Keep shard 2 on an SSD.

caveats: Card accuracy: IQ3_XXS keeps 99.4% of the BF16 task average (92.57 vs 93.12) at 75.8 GB vs 354 GB.
The card's speed table (Q2_0 93.79 decode tok/s, IQ2_XS 70.30) does not say which hardware, so it is not recorded as a measurement here.
Whether the -lm/--lazy-mode flags exist in your llama.cpp build is not checked here; the card states them.
